description: Generates a video clip from text with optional background music (Vidu Q2).

prompt.description: A textual description for video generation, with a maximum length of 2000 characters.

aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the output video.

duration.description: Duration of the output video in seconds.

seed.description: Seed for video generation (0 for random).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

background_music.description: Whether to add background music to the generated video. Wire field: `bgm`.
